patch.value: GH-682: linked-test tracker sandbox must preserve source VCS workspace identity

Preserve an explicit read-only source workspace and VCS root when pm test executes with a sandboxed tracker so Git-aware SDK and package commands observe the same tags and repository metadata as direct execution while tracker writes remain isolated.
